<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C9H7O4 (C=9, H=7, N=0, X=0), the calculation yields DBE = (2*9 + 2 - 7)/2 = 13/2 = 6.5. Since DBE must be an integer for a stable molecule, the nearest integer value is 7.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
